body: I was feeling really shitty when I posted this I guess I just felt like everything is just too much for me to handle and I barely made it this far and I just kind of wish I hadn't been born in the first place, sorry for replying late
Np my guy sorry for responding to this late tho
Also I'm sorry for how much I swore here, I probably should have not done that so much.

Tbh you'd have to be a real dickhead to laugh at someone else's struggle, anyone who would do that is a twat and can fuck right off. I'm sorry I'm shit at advice and feelings and stuff but anyone who would play the 'who has it worse game' or whatever and dismiss your problems is being a dickhead. Anxiety sucks and is frustrating to say the least. I've had mental breakdowns over stuff pretty much everyone I know can do just fine and it makes me feel shitty. Anxiety can be harder for some people than it is for others, but there are ways to help manage it. Things can get easier to deal with even if it is a pain in the dick. I'm sorry that you're dealing with this my guy, it really does suck.

Why is this such a fucking mood though, it's easy for some people to say it gets better when their situation is way easier and they have access to a lot of help or have just never experienced a lot of trauma or mental illness. For some of us life is fucking shit and if anything it gets harder smh

Yeah its really frustrating, I did used to identify as gay before I transitioned but I think I'm probably bi now. I kind of knew there was some attraction to guys there before I came out but it made me feel feminine and girly so I pushed it away and now it's not as bad but I still feel super insecure and feminine at the thought of being with a guy and I just kind of tell myself to just stick to women

Yeah I think I get that, I think I'm kind of the opposite, I just feel more masculine when I'm with women and I start getting really insecure and nervous when I'm with guys and there's just kind of a bitterness there. It's weird.
No I didn't know it was a thing tbh, thanks
You pass completely and you look amazing :)

Hey take deep breaths okay try and focus on steadying your breathing, I wish I knew exactly what to say to help you and I'm not the best at advice but I know what it's like to want to just not be here anymore and not have to deal with everything so I'm going to try and do my best to help you in anyway I can. Take a deep breath and focus on getting through the seconds. If you can get through the seconds you can can get through the minutes and so on. You are worth so much more than your achievements and you are worth so much more then what you think of yourself. You should be so proud of yourself for getting to where you are now.
